title: Pay gaming machine tax
what: Pay gaming machine tax each month on the licensed premises.

sources.title: Gaming Machine Act 1995 (NT)
sources.quote: A licensee shall pay, or cause to be paid, in the manner prescribed a gaming machine tax to the Director each month in respect of the licensee's licensed premises
